High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Nitin Parashar - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Sonal Gupta - Additional Advocate General for the
 respondent/State.
Shri Anugrah Sharma - Advocate for the objector/complainant.

Heard on I.A No.5889/2024 an application under Section 302(1) of the Cr.P.C.
For the reasons stated in the application, the victim is permitted to represent the case through counsel.
Accordingly, I.A No.5889/2024 is allowed and disposed off.
Also, heard on I.A No.6413/2024 an application for taking documents on record.
For the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed and the proposed documents are taken on record.
Accordingly, I.A No.6413/2024 is allowed and disposed off.

Heard on I.A No.18936/2023 an application for suspension of sentence under Section 430 of BNSS/389 of the Cr.P.C, 1973 is filed for suspension of execution of remaining sentence of the sole appellant/accused.

The appellant/accused has been convicted under Section 376(2)(K), 376(2)(F), 376(3), 323 and 506 part-II of the IPC and Section 5(n)/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012 and sentenced for Life Imprisonment,
Life 2 CRA-15607-2023 Imprisonment, Life Imprisonment, 01 year R.I, 01 year R.I, Life Imprisonment to run concurrently with fine and default stipulations respectively.

The sole appellant has been convicted vide judgment dated 28.06.2023 passed in Special Case No.178/2021 by XVth Additional Sessions Judge and Special Judge, POCSO, Indore for committing sexual assault towards victim (PW-1) who is below the age of 16 years on 02.07.2021 on the basis of date of birth i.e.
27.10.2005.
Appellant/accused is the biological father of the victim (PW-1).

I.A No.18936/2023 is preferred on the ground that there is no independent witness examined by the Santosh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166958642/
1 prosecution.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The judgment and conviction of sentence has been passed without considering the contradictions in the evidence presented before the trial Court.
The trial Court has committed error in discarding the defence version.
In arguments it is also mentioned that FIR is lodged with delay and does not support the prosecution.
The appellant/accused has filed the copy of statement of bank account of mother of the victim as well as the copy of statement of bank account of appellant/accused.
He further submits that he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The final hearing of the appeal would take considerable long time for its disposal hence, its prayed that application be allowed.
The application has been opposed on behalf of the victim by filing the reply through I.A No.5890/2024.

Learned counsel for the respondent/State has also opposed the application by filing reply through document No.1019/2024.
3 CRA-15607-2023 Heard and perused the record.
Considering the statement of victim (PW-1) and her mother (PW-2), we are not inclined to suspend the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant/accused at present.
Accordingly, I.A No.18936/2023 is hereby rejected.
(SUSHRUT ARVIND DHARMADHIKARI)

(GAJENDRA  JUDGE JUDG  akanksha Santosh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166958642/
